title: Sandy’s Seacrest | Spacious Seacrest Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Sandy’s Seacrest is a pet-friendly, one-level Seacrest home with a private pool, fenced yard, bikes, and quick access to the beach and 30A dining.
description_expanded: Tucked away among the quiet Seabreeze neighborhood in Seacrest, this beautiful and comfortable home is perfect for your entire family. Even your pup! What makes this quiet street even better is how close it is to the Seabreeze Beach Access - less than 2 min by bike! In biking distance to shopping and dining at The Big Chill and Waterhouse Sandwich and Wine Bar. The magical and lush landscaped backyard sets the stage for a relaxing and restorative time.
